subject_description_en: The main subject is a standard professional fire extinguisher with an upright bright-red metal cylindrical body, a black squeeze handle on top, a metal valve assembly, and a black discharge hose extending from the upper side. The center front of the cylinder contains a natural large instruction-text area, and the overall silhouette is compact, vertical, and functionally unmistakable. The subject must remain this type of standard red fire extinguisher without changing its identity, metal cylindrical body, top handle-and-valve structure, black hose, or the placement of the front text area.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个标准专业灭火器，整体为直立的鲜红色金属圆柱瓶身，顶部装有黑色压把、金属阀门组件和一根从顶部侧面伸出的黑色喷射软管。瓶身正面中央留有自然的大面积说明文字区域，整体轮廓紧凑、垂直、功能性明确。主体必须保持为这种标准红色灭火器的外观，保持其金属圆柱瓶身、顶部压把阀门结构、黑色软管和正面文字区位置不变。
text_anchor_en: on the front of the extinguisher cylinder

subject_description_en: The main subject is a standard front-facing gas pump with a tall, narrow, upright rectangular body. The upper section contains a digital display screen, the middle section contains a keypad or payment/control panel, and the lower section contains the dispensing and instruction area. A fuel nozzle hangs along one side, attached to a long dark hose that falls vertically along the machine. The front panel is flat, with a natural main text position in the center or upper front section. The subject must remain this type of standard gas pump without changing its identity, upright rectangular silhouette, display placement, nozzle-and-hose structure, or overall equipment layout.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个标准加油机的正面视图，整体为高而窄的矩形立式机身。上部设有数字显示屏，中部是按键、支付或操作面板区域，下部是取油和说明区域；机身一侧悬挂油枪，油枪连接一根较长的黑色软管，沿侧面垂落。前面板平整，正面中央或上半部分留有自然的主标识文字位。主体必须保持为这种标准加油机，不要改变其身份、矩形立式轮廓、显示面板位置、油枪与软管结构或整体设备布局。
text_anchor_en: at the most prominent position on the front of the gas pump

subject_description_en: The main subject is a standard first-aid box with a hard rectangular case body, compact proportions, softened corners, and a handle on top. The center of the front panel is the natural main label area, and the lid edge is clearly defined against the body, giving the box a simple, sturdy, portable structure. The subject must remain this type of first-aid box without changing its identity, rectangular case silhouette, top handle, front lid edge, or the central main label area.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个标准急救箱，整体为硬质矩形箱体，长宽比例紧凑，边角较钝，顶部有提手。正面中央是最自然的主标识区域，箱盖与箱体之间有明确的开合边缘，整体结构简洁、稳固、便携。主体必须保持为这种急救箱，不要改变其身份、矩形箱体轮廓、顶部提手、前盖开合边缘或正面中央主标识区。
text_anchor_en: at the center of the front of the first-aid box

subject_description_en: The main subject is a standard front-facing electrical panel with a flat metal rectangular cabinet body and a clearly defined front door outline. The panel door shows a visible border frame or hinge relationship along the edges, and a small handle or lock area appears on the door. The upper front section is the natural position for warning text, and the surface should look like painted metal with a strong industrial appearance. The subject must remain this type of electrical panel without changing its identity, rectangular metal door, edge frame or hinge structure, handle-lock placement, or upper warning-text area.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个标准配电箱正面，整体为平整的金属矩形箱体，正面有完整的箱门轮廓，门板边缘能看到明显的固定边框或铰接关系。箱门上有小型把手或锁孔区域，正面上半部分是自然的危险警示文字区域。整体质感偏喷涂金属，工业感强。主体必须保持为这种配电箱，不要改变其身份、矩形金属箱门、边缘固定或铰接结构、把手锁孔位置或上半部警示文字区。
text_anchor_en: on the upper front area of the electrical panel

subject_description_en: The main subject is a standard front-facing postal drop box with an upright metal box body, a protruding mail slot or slanted top deposit structure at the upper front edge, and a large front access panel below. The center or upper front serves as the natural main label area, and the overall silhouette is thick, regular, and clearly civic in appearance. The subject must remain this type of postal drop box without changing its identity, upright metal body, top deposit slot, front access panel, or the placement of the front text area.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个标准邮政投递箱正面，整体为直立的金属箱体，顶部前缘带有向前伸出的投递口或带斜盖的投递结构，下方是大面积前门面板。箱体正面中央或上半部是自然的主标识文字区域，整体轮廓厚实、规则、公共设施感明确。主体必须保持为这种邮政投递箱，不要改变其身份、直立金属箱体、顶部投递口、前门面板或正面文字区位置。
text_anchor_en: at the most prominent position on the front of the postal drop box

subject_description_en: The main subject is a front view of a public telephone booth with a tall narrow vertical enclosure. A separate horizontal sign band appears at the top, while the middle section contains an entrance opening or transparent front panel, and the left and right sides are enclosed by transparent or semi-transparent side panels. The telephone equipment is visible inside in the upper-middle area, and the top band serves as the natural main label area. The subject must remain this type of public telephone booth without changing its identity, vertical booth silhouette, top sign band, transparent side panels, or the internal telephone position.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个公共电话亭的正面视图，整体为高而窄的亭体结构，顶部有单独的横向主标识带，中部是开口入口或透明前面板，左右两侧为透明或半透明围挡。内部电话设备区域位于中上部，亭体轮廓垂直明确，顶部文字区是自然的主标识位置。主体必须保持为这种公共电话亭，不要改变其身份、竖直亭体轮廓、顶部主标识带、透明侧围挡或内部电话设备位置。
text_anchor_en: on the front top area of the telephone booth

subject_description_en: The main subject is a standard front view of a vending machine with a tall rectangular body. Most of the front surface is occupied by a transparent product display window, inside which multiple rows of item slots are arranged in a regular grid. Beside or below the display window are the selection or price keypad area, payment area, and pickup compartment, while the top serves as the natural main sign band. The subject must remain this type of vending machine without changing its identity, tall rectangular silhouette, transparent display window, slot arrangement, pickup compartment, or top text band. A typical vending-machine front is structured as “top brand area + large display window + control or pickup area.”
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个标准自动售货机的正面视图，整体为高矩形机身，正面大部分区域由透明商品展示窗占据，展示窗内部有多层规则排列的商品格位。展示窗旁或下方设有按键或价格选择面板、支付区域和取货口，顶部留有自然的主标识文字区。主体必须保持为这种自动售货机，不要改变其身份、高矩形轮廓、透明展示窗、商品格位排列、取货口或顶部主文字区。典型售货机正面通常由“上部品牌区 + 大型展示窗 + 面板或取货区”构成。
text_anchor_en: on the front top area of the vending machine

subject_description_en: The main subject is a standard front view of a recycling-bin station composed of multiple side-by-side compartments, each with its own disposal opening at the top or upper front. The compartments are separated by clear vertical divider structures, and the front panels naturally support sorting labels and instruction text. The overall appearance should feel durable and civic. The subject must remain this type of recycling-bin station without changing its identity, multi-compartment layout, separate disposal openings, front sorting-text areas, or overall public-facility appearance.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个标准垃圾分类回收箱的正面视图，整体由多个并列箱体组成，每个箱体顶部或上前方有独立投入口。箱体之间用明确的竖向分隔结构区分，前面板适合承载分类名称和说明文字。整体外观耐用、公共设施感强。主体必须保持为这种垃圾分类回收箱，不要改变其身份、并列箱体结构、各自独立的投入口、前面板分类文字区或整体公共设施外观。
text_anchor_en: at the most prominent position on the front of the recycling bin station

subject_description_en: The main subject is a classic vintage glass soda bottle with a very distinctive “slender neck + rounded belly + pinched waist” contour silhouette: a narrow elongated neck at the top, outward-rounded shoulders in the upper middle, a sharply narrowed waist, and a lower section that widens again before tapering toward the base. The glass body shows vertical rib-like contour lines or embossed shaping, and the middle front is the natural large brand-text area. The subject must remain this type of contour glass soda bottle without changing its identity, narrow-neck silhouette, rounded-belly and pinched-waist relationship, glass material, vertical contour ribs, or the central main text area. The key visual identity of the classic contour bottle is the narrow neck, pinched waist, and flowing vertical rib structure.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个经典的复古玻璃汽水瓶，整体为明显的“细颈 + 鼓肚 + 收腰”曲线轮廓：上部是细长瓶颈，中段肩部向外鼓起，腰部明显内收，下半部再次外扩并收到底部。玻璃瓶身带有纵向起伏筋线或立体浮雕感，正面中部是最自然的大面积品牌文字区域。主体必须保持为这种曲线玻璃汽水瓶，不要改变其身份、细颈轮廓、鼓肚与收腰关系、玻璃材质、纵向筋线或中部主文字区。经典 contour bottle 的核心视觉特征正是细颈、收腰和纵向流线筋线。
text_anchor_en: in the middle front area of the bottle

subject_description_en: The main subject is a common amber prescription bottle with a short stable cylindrical body made of translucent deep amber plastic. On top is a relatively short, wide white screw cap, and the front contains one large flat label panel. The overall proportion is compact, with a regular front panel and a high label-area ratio. The subject must remain this type of amber prescription bottle without changing its identity, cylindrical silhouette, deep-amber translucent material, wide white cap, or large front label panel.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个常见的琥珀色处方药瓶，整体为短而稳的圆柱形瓶身，材质半透明，颜色偏深琥珀色。顶部是较短、较宽的白色旋盖，正面有一整块平整的大标签区域。整体比例紧凑，前面板规则，标签区占比高。主体必须保持为这种琥珀色处方药瓶，不要改变其身份、圆柱轮廓、深琥珀半透明材质、宽白色瓶盖或正面大标签区。
text_anchor_en: on the large front label area

subject_description_en: The main subject is a standard baby bottle with a transparent or semi-transparent body and a relatively straight bottle shape. Vertical measurement markings are visible on the front. At the top is a wide threaded cap with a rounded soft nipple, and the nipple has a clearly visible broad base. The shoulders are broad, and the middle front naturally supports brand or function text. The subject must remain this type of baby bottle without changing its identity, transparent body, measurement markings, wide-neck cap, rounded nipple, or middle main text area. Wide-neck construction and a soft silicone nipple are typical visual features of baby bottles.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个标准婴儿奶瓶，整体为透明或半透明瓶身，瓶体较直，正面可见纵向刻度线。顶部是宽口螺纹瓶盖和圆润柔软的奶嘴，奶嘴底部有明显的宽基座结构。瓶肩较宽，正面中部是自然的品牌或功能说明文字区域。主体必须保持为这种婴儿奶瓶，不要改变其身份、透明瓶身、刻度线、宽口瓶盖、圆润奶嘴或中部主文字区。宽口奶瓶和软硅胶奶嘴是典型视觉特征。
text_anchor_en: in the middle front area of the bottle

subject_description_en: The main subject is a large pump-top hand-wash bottle with a tall body, a broad flat front panel, and a press pump mounted at the top center, with the nozzle extending horizontally to one side. The shoulders are rounded, and the body is typically transparent, semi-transparent, or light-colored rigid plastic, with a natural large label area in the lower-middle front. The subject must remain this type of large hand-wash bottle without changing its identity, tall bottle proportion, top pump, side-extending nozzle, flat front panel, or large label area. A typical hand-wash bottle is defined by an upright body combined with a top press pump.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个大容量泵头洗手液瓶，整体瓶身较高、前面板宽而平整，顶部中央安装按压式泵头，泵嘴向一侧水平伸出。瓶肩圆润，瓶体通常为透明、半透明或浅色硬质塑料，正面中下部留有自然的大标签区域。主体必须保持为这种大瓶洗手液瓶，不要改变其身份、高瓶身比例、顶部泵头、侧向泵嘴、平整前面板或大标签区。典型手洗瓶的共同特征是直立瓶身加顶部按压泵头。
text_anchor_en: on the lower-middle front of the bottle

subject_description_en: The main subject is a standard motor-oil jug with a thick plastic body whose silhouette is boxy or rounded-rectangular, a large side handle, and an angled pouring spout with a screw cap at the top front. The front panel is broad and relatively flat, naturally supporting brand text, viscosity grade, and functional information. The subject must remain this type of motor-oil jug without changing its identity, thick jug silhouette, side handle, angled spout, screw cap, or large front label area. A typical motor-oil jug is visually defined by the combination of a side handle and a forward-angled spout.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个标准机油壶，整体为厚实的塑料壶身，轮廓偏方形或圆角矩形，一侧带有大尺寸把手，顶部前方有倾斜的出液口和旋盖。壶身前面板较大、较平整，适合放置品牌名、黏度规格和功能说明。主体必须保持为这种机油壶，不要改变其身份、厚实壶身轮廓、侧把手、倾斜出液口、旋盖或正面大标签区。典型机油壶的关键视觉特征就是侧把手加前倾出液口。
text_anchor_en: on the large front label area

subject_description_en: The main subject is a large mouthwash bottle with a tall body, broad gently sloping shoulders, and a rigid transparent or semi-transparent plastic form. The top has a clearly visible screw-cap structure, and the front panel is broad enough to support large functional text in the middle or lower front area. The subject must remain this type of large mouthwash bottle without changing its identity, tall bottle proportion, broad shoulder silhouette, screw-cap structure, or main front label area. A typical mouthwash bottle is characterized by a tall body, broad shoulders, rigid plastic, and a large label panel.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个大容量漱口水瓶，整体瓶身较高，肩部宽而平缓，瓶体通常为硬质透明或半透明塑料。顶部是明显的旋盖结构，前面板宽阔，正面中部或下半部适合放置大面积功能文字。主体必须保持为这种大瓶漱口水瓶，不要改变其身份、高瓶身比例、宽肩轮廓、旋盖结构或正面主标签区。典型漱口水瓶通常是高瓶身、宽肩、硬质瓶体加大面积标签。
text_anchor_en: on the middle or lower front label area
text_anchor_zh: 正面中部或下半部标签区

subject_description_en: The main subject is a large laundry-detergent jug with a thick high-capacity plastic body, a clearly visible side handle, and a top pouring spout with a screw cap. The front label area is usually very large and occupies most of the visual area on the front, and the front panel is broad and stable. The subject must remain this type of laundry-detergent jug without changing its identity, broad thick body silhouette, handle, top pouring spout, screw cap, or large front label area. A typical detergent jug is defined by its high-capacity body, integrated handle, and oversized front label.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个大容量洗衣液壶，整体为厚实的大塑料壶身，一侧有明显把手，顶部出液口带旋盖。正面标签区域通常很大，占据瓶身正面主要视觉面积。壶身轮廓稳定、容量感强，前面板宽阔。主体必须保持为这种洗衣液壶，不要改变其身份、宽厚壶身轮廓、把手、顶部出液口、旋盖或正面大标签区。典型洗衣液壶往往是高容量、有把手、正面大标签的家清容器。
text_anchor_en: on the large front label area

subject_description_en: The main subject is a standard cough-syrup bottle with a dark glass or dark plastic body, a compact stable bottle proportion, and a relatively small screw cap on top. A clearly defined medicine-label area appears on the front, and the label typically occupies a large proportion of the visible front surface. The subject must remain this type of cough-syrup bottle without changing its identity, dark bottle material, compact proportion, screw-cap structure, or front medicine-label area.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个标准止咳糖浆瓶，整体为深色玻璃或深色塑料瓶身，瓶体比例短而稳，顶部为较小的旋盖。正面有明显药品标签区域，标签通常占据瓶身正面较大比例。主体必须保持为这种止咳糖浆瓶，不要改变其身份、深色瓶身材质、紧凑瓶体比例、旋盖结构或正面药品标签区。
text_anchor_en: on the front medicine-label area

subject_name_zh: 有毒警示牌（骷髅警示牌）
subject_description_en: The main subject is a yellow triangular danger warning sign with a clearly defined three-sided silhouette and a thick black triangular border. At the center is a prominent black skull-and-crossbones pictogram: a front-facing skull above two crossed bones, forming a highly recognizable high-contrast hazard symbol. A natural main warning-text area appears below the pictogram, creating a typical graphic-on-top and warning-text-below danger-sign layout. The subject must remain this specific triangular toxic warning sign, without changing its identity, yellow triangular silhouette, thick black border, central skull-and-crossbones pictogram, or the positional relationship of the main warning text area below.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个黄色三角形危险警示牌，三边轮廓清晰，边缘有粗黑色三角外框。三角形中央印有一个醒目的黑色骷髅与交叉骨图案：骷髅正面朝前，两个骨头呈交叉状位于下方，整体高对比、识别性极强。骷髅交叉骨图形下方保留一条自然的主警示文字区域，整体形成典型的“危险图形在上、主警示文字在下”的高对比警示布局。主体必须保持为这种三角形有毒警示牌，不要改变其主体身份、黄色三角轮廓、粗黑边框、中央骷髅交叉骨图形以及下方主警示文字区域的位置关系。
text_anchor_en: below the skull-and-crossbones pictogram

subject_description_en: The main subject is a yellow triangular high-voltage warning sign with a thick black triangular border. At the center is a prominent black lightning pictogram with a bold angular zigzag shape slashing downward, creating a strong visual hazard cue. A natural main warning-text area appears below the lightning symbol, forming a standard high-voltage danger-sign layout. The subject must remain this specific high-voltage warning sign, without changing its identity, yellow triangular silhouette, thick black border, central black lightning pictogram, or the positional relationship of the main warning text area below.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个黄色三角形高压危险警示牌，边缘有粗黑色三角外框。三角形中央是一个醒目的黑色闪电 pictogram，闪电线条较粗，整体呈锐角折线形，从上向下斜切，视觉冲击强烈。闪电图形下方保留一条自然的主警示文字区域，整体形成标准的高压电危险警示牌结构。主体必须保持为这种高压危险牌，不要改变其主体身份、黄色三角轮廓、粗黑边框、中央黑色闪电图形以及下方主警示文字区域的位置关系。
text_anchor_en: below the lightning pictogram

subject_description_en: The main subject is a yellow triangular biohazard warning sign with a clear black triangular border. At the center is a prominent black biohazard pictogram composed of three curved symmetrical units arranged in a highly recognizable radial structure. A natural main warning-text area appears below the symbol, forming a typical high-contrast biohazard sign layout. The subject must remain this specific biohazard warning sign, without changing its identity, yellow triangular silhouette, black triangular border, central biohazard symbol, or the positional relationship of the main warning text area below.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个黄色三角形生物危害警示牌，边缘有清晰的黑色三角外框。三角形中央印有醒目的黑色生物危害符号，该符号由三个相互环绕的弯曲对称单元组成，整体形成高度识别性的放射状结构。符号下方保留一条自然的主警示文字区域，整体呈现典型的生物危害高对比警示布局。主体必须保持为这种生物危害警示牌，不要改变其主体身份、黄色三角轮廓、黑色三角边框、中央生物危害图形以及下方主警示文字区域的位置关系。
text_anchor_en: below the biohazard symbol

subject_description_en: The main subject is a standard no-swimming sign commonly placed near public waters. At the center is a clear swimmer pictogram covered by a red circular prohibition ring and a diagonal red slash, together forming a stable and highly recognizable prohibition structure. The pictogram and slash are centered on the sign, with a natural main warning-text area below. The subject must remain this specific no-swimming sign, without changing its identity, circular prohibition outline, swimmer pictogram, red slash, or the positional relationship of the main warning text area.
subject_description_zh: 画面主体是一个公共水域边常见的禁止游泳标识牌。标识中央是一个清晰的人体游泳姿态 pictogram，外部覆盖红色圆形禁止环和一条斜向红色禁止线，红色圆环与斜线共同形成稳定醒目的禁止结构。图形与禁止线位于标识中央，下方保留自然的主警示文字区域。主体必须保持为这种禁止游泳标识牌，不要改变其主体身份、圆形禁止轮廓、游泳人体图形、红色斜杠以及主警示文字区域的位置关系。
text_anchor_en: in the main warning text area below the pictogram
text_anchor_zh: 图形下方主警示文字区

subject_description_en: The main subject is a yellow triangular deep-water danger sign with a thick black triangular border. At the center is a clear high-contrast pictogram showing a person near water or falling into deep water, accompanied by visible wave lines that directly convey deep-water danger. A natural main warning-text area appears below the graphic, forming a typical public-water hazard sign layout. The subject must remain this specific deep-water danger sign, without changing its identity, yellow triangular silhouette, black border, central deep-water danger pictogram, or the positional relationship of the main warning text area below.
